name: Automatic Garage Order
author: jor
description: Reorders the pitlane garages in Career Mode each season according to the result of the previous season.

options.label: Enable mod
options.description: Enable or disable automatic pitlane garage reordering.

options.label: Apply in Season 1
options.description: Apply realistic 2024/2025 constructor standings in Season 1 (McLaren in Garage 1, Ferrari in Garage 2, etc.).

options.label: Reverse garage order
options.description: Inverts the pitlane garage order (the reigning champion takes the last garage).

options.label: Verbose logging
options.description: Log team names and assigned pitlane garage slots to swofty/loader.log.
